microContent.title: 5 Morning Routine Hacks That Actually Changed My Life [Data-Backed]
microContent.body:
**TL;DR:** I tried 12 different morning routines over 6 months. Here are the 5 that actually moved the needle.

**1. Cold exposure (2 min shower)**
Studies show cold exposure increases norepinephrine by 200-300%. I noticed sharper focus within the first week.

**2. No phone for first 30 minutes**
This one was the hardest but most impactful. My anxiety dropped noticeably when I stopped doom-scrolling before breakfast.

**3. Movement before caffeine**
Even 10 minutes of walking before coffee made a difference. The research backs this — exercise primes your cortisol response.

**4. Journaling (just 5 minutes)**
Not fancy journaling. Just writing three things I want to accomplish. Kept me focused all day.

**5. Protein-first breakfast**
Switching from cereal to eggs + greens was a game changer for sustained energy.

---

What morning habits have worked for you? I'm always looking to experiment.
